discovered_problem: Stage 12 candidates carried predicate, object assertion, modality, multiple entities, conditions, negation, applicability and Evidence lineage, while the Stage 9 runtime projection and recorded Stage 9 ontology/SHACL audit did not provide a lossless validated representation.

evidence.detail: 总计划 requires Stage 9 OWL/SHACL runtime gating and Stage 12 complete Engineering Statement semantics.
In-memory projection inspection showed the previous representation retained only a subset of candidate semantics while validation still passed.
Stage 12 could not prove predicate/object/modality/multi-entity/condition preservation through the Stage 9 consumer.

why_change_is_required: This is a verified cross-stage semantic compatibility defect, not a naming or convenience change; dropping the fields would make a passing runtime gate misleading.
alternatives_considered: Keep Stage 9 optional fields and rely on the Stage 12 adapter only
Add the minimum Stage 9 vocabulary and runtime projection checks
reason_alternatives_rejected: Adapter-only checks would not make the Stage 9 consumer representation auditable
Deleting fields violates the lossless semantic requirement
The minimum vocabulary and projection extension preserves existing Stage 9 inputs while covering the proven downstream need
